findings.summary: A missing reviewed ledger is reported as no candidates
findings.evidence: A previously inventoried ledger is omitted when absent; status selects no_candidates. Deleting the ledger after enrolling a reproduced no_candidates for status and reconcile. SPEC AC-001 requires source_incomplete.
findings.suggestion: Compare current sources to accepted inventory and committed member references even with no candidates; report the missing ledger path.

reasoning.observe: Inspected complete collector, PLAN ADR-002 and SPEC AC-001.
reasoning.trace: Ledger deletion removes its inventory key and start, leaving no bad-source marker.
reasoning.infer: Previously observed work becomes indistinguishable from an accepted empty snapshot.
reasoning.conclude: A missing reviewed source is incorrectly reported as no work.

findings.summary: A later acknowledgment bypasses drift in reviewed source bytes
findings.evidence: The extension branch accepts an inventory mismatch without verifying historical source hashes. Changing reviewed PLAN-a.md and adding acknowledged b reproduced enrollment of b. SPEC requires changed source identities to invalidate coverage.
findings.suggestion: Verify historical source identities before accepting extension; handle artifact moves through an explicit validated source relation.

reasoning.observe: Inspected complete coverage/reconciliation path, PLAN ADR-002 and SPEC AC-005.
reasoning.trace: An inventory mismatch enters acknowledged_extension when frozen tasks and starts still match.
reasoning.infer: The collector commits a new member across an unreviewed change to accepted sources.
reasoning.conclude: The reviewed coverage boundary is bypassed.

findings.summary: Terminal events without evidence can produce a passed trial
findings.evidence: Terminality checks only event kind while evidence checks observation refs. Three bare terminal events, observations and pass assessments reproduced collection complete and outcome passed. SPEC requires terminal evidence references.
findings.suggestion: Require cited terminal evidence before a terminal event can satisfy complete or passed; report missing closeout evidence as insufficient.

reasoning.observe: Inspected complete status derivation and approved SPEC evidence/outcome rules.
reasoning.trace: Bare terminal events satisfy completion; observation refs and pass assessments satisfy passed.
reasoning.infer: A task with no cited closeout contributes to successful trial.
reasoning.conclude: The passed outcome can be awarded without required terminal evidence.

findings.summary: Task document start claim can bypass source review
findings.evidence: Event task_slug is not checked against artifact owner or authoritative ledger. A foreign start in a registered task document can be enrolled without source review.
findings.suggestion: Validate event task identity, document owner and first start against ledger; require source review if not corroborated.

reasoning.observe: Inspected full implementation, PLAN 55-65 and SPEC 103-109.
reasoning.trace: Collector accepts a start event from another task's artifact and coverage sees its existence.
reasoning.infer: Task document input gets cohort decision authority without independent attribution.
reasoning.conclude: Unverified task document data can determine a cohort slot.

findings.summary: Non-object JSON ledger record crashes trial status
findings.evidence: json.loads accepts [] but subsequent item.get raises AttributeError, not caught by the current exception handler.
findings.suggestion: Check every deserialized record is a dict; surface source_incomplete with path for invalid shapes.

reasoning.observe: Inspected full collector and SPEC missing/unreadable input rules; malformed JSON syntax is already caught.
reasoning.trace: A ledger line [] makes _source_snapshot raise AttributeError from item.get.
reasoning.infer: A single malformed-shape record prevents status and reconcile on every retry.
reasoning.conclude: The active trial can become unqueryable from valid non-object JSON.

findings.summary: Order-conflict test omits affected source or task
findings.evidence: The test accepts either conflict reason and checks no locator. Equal-time status returns source=None. SPEC AC-005 requires a reason and affected source or task.
findings.suggestion: Assert the specific order_conflict reason and a public diagnostic identifying competing starts or their source.

reasoning.observe: Read full SPEC, PLAN, test and status implementation.
reasoning.trace: Lines 286-296 check a broad reason only; current equal-time response lacks locator.
reasoning.infer: A generic conflict with no actionable source passes the test.
reasoning.conclude: Test fails to catch a required diagnostic-contract defect.
